thought.text: The admin login failed with invalid credentials. Let me investigate.

reasoning_content:
Login failed with invalid email/password. Interesting! The summary claimed login works. Let me check the user's password. Maybe password is different. Let me test via rails runner. But careful not to modify. Reading is fine. Let me try rails runner to check authentication — that's diagnostic, not modifying. Actually running rails runner boots app; okay.

Let me check the admin user attributes.

action.command: cd /workspace && source /etc/profile.d/rvm-fnm.sh 2>/dev/null; DISABLE_SPRING=1 timeout 180 bin/rails runner 'u=User.find_by(email:"admin@consul.dev"); puts u.inspect; puts "valid_pw=#{u.valid_password?("Aa12345678")}"; puts "confirmed=#{u.confirmed?}"; puts "admin=#{u.administrator?}"; puts "encrypted=#{u.encrypted_password[0,20]}"' 2>&1 | tail -20
